**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep agmsg-dispatch excluded on Linux until delivery works**

On a Linux Claude worker, emptying `linux_excluded_commands` moves `agmsg-dispatch` into the bubblewrap sandbox even though the repository's Worker Playbook still requires it to run through `excludedCommands`, and the existing Linux evidence records the Herdr socket call failing with `PermissionDenied`. Such a worker can write its result but cannot wake the idle orchestrator as step 11 requires; the threat table merely labels Linux runtime unmeasured and names a follow-up for which no task file exists in the repository, so it does not mitigate the regression.
